To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

, under the TSRB strategy and when the rumor dies, the rumor is restrained by a truth-spreading mechanism if the rumor is more contagious than the truth, and the truth is restrained by a rumor-blocking mechanism if the truth is more contagious than a rumor.

the effectiveness of the tradeoff strategy is determined by the basic parameters and network structures of a rumor and the spreading truth, and that it can be assessed by a set of criteria based on the generic URQT or linear URQT model.
the effectiveness of the strategy depends on the network structures and the basic parameters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the theoretical foundation of the TSRB rumor-inhibiting strategy.
the effectiveness of the rumor-blocking/truth-spreading strategy.
the effectiveness of the rumor-blocking strategy, the effectiveness of the spreading strategy, and the effectiveness of the tradeoff between them.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the effectiveness of the strategy increases with the ratio of the truth to the rumor spreading speed, the rumor spreading threshold, the ratio of the rumor to the truth spreading range and the ratio of the number of truth spreaders to the number of rumor spreaders.
, when the TSRB strategy works well, the truth will spread faster than the rumor and the rumor will die out.

, for the URQT model, if the truth-spreading rate is sufficiently large or the rumor-blocking rate is sufficiently small, a rumor would die out; and if the truth-spreader density is sufficiently large or if the rumor-blocker density is sufficiently small, the TSRB strategy is effective.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, when a rumor dies out, its spreading speed, its initial spreading rate, and the network structures are the three key factors that influence the effectiveness of the rumor blocking and truth spreading.
the TSRB strategy can effectively restrain rumors.

the TSRB strategy may be effective for inhibiting rumors if the rumor is not too strong and the network structure is not too dense, and the TSRB strategy is not effective if the rumor is too strong and the density of the network is too high.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TSRB strategy is effective in restraining rumors.
the TSRB strategy is more effective when the rumor is more contagious and the truth is more credible.
, when the TSRB strategy is effective, it can achieve an excellent cost-effectiveness, which is much better than the effectiveness of either the truth spreading or the rumor blocking alone.
